svg.title: Chapter 5, how success is measured: 1 the percentage of users selecting a language other than English, a proxy for latent demand; 2 notes open rate by language segment against the English baseline; 3 session duration growth after the language launch; 4 conversion rate after the first lesson is experienced; 5 support ticket drop after the language doubt launch. The chain: understanding builds confidence, confidence drives engagement, engagement drives conversion. Closing line: Let Eureka prove itself. Let them learn, then let them choose. The opportunity is not to change how students learn but to remove what prevents them from learning. The strongest path to conversion is not persuasion, it is comprehension.
